attr.title: ReConflict
attr.desc: An experimental ARM64 community port for Conflict: Desert Storm, using SDL2 and OpenGL ES. Players supply the English GOG Windows 1.0 build21657 installer.
attr.inst: Put setup_conflict_-_desert_storm_1.0_(21657).exe in reconflict/ and launch ReConflict. Python3.9+ is required. The SDL launcher extracts and verifies the files, then offers to keep or delete the installer. Allow 2 GiB free before copying it. Tested firmware: 64-bit muOS on H700.
